title: Post-TKR Pain Management
content: Supra Ortho uses Paracetamol 650mg QDS as first-line post-TKR (Total Knee Replacement) pain management. Escalate to Tramadol 50mg if VAS (pain score) > 6. AVOID NSAIDs at all steps due to surgical bleeding risk. Decision by Dr. Vikram, January 2025.

title: Patient Rajan Drug Alert
content: ABSOLUTE: No ibuprofen, no aspirin, no diclofenac for patient Rajan. Cardiac stent placed 2022, currently on dual antiplatelet therapy. Previous 8 NSAID refusals documented in chart. Family also requests avoidance — refuse NSAID requests firmly and offer Paracetamol as the safe alternative.

title: Sepsis Protocol v3
content: Supra Sepsis Bundle v3 (2026, current version): draw blood cultures BEFORE giving antibiotics, get lactate within 1 HOUR (this was tightened from v2's 3-hour window — always use the 1-hour rule now), give 30mL/kg crystalloid fluid for hypotension, start vasopressors if MAP stays below 65 after fluids.

title: DVT Prophylaxis
content: ALL ortho surgical patients receive DVT prophylaxis: Enoxaparin 40mg SC (subcutaneous) once daily, starting 12 hours post-op. Duration: 14 days for TKR (Total Knee Replacement), 28 days for THR (Total Hip Replacement).

title: Diabetic Fasting Protocol
content: For fasting patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: adjust insulin timing, not dose. Skip Glimepiride on fast days. Continue Metformin with the evening meal.

title: TKR Discharge Rule
content: Do NOT discharge TKR (Total Knee Replacement) patients before 48 hours post-op. Past incident: a patient discharged at 36 hours developed DVT at home and required emergency readmission. 48-hour minimum stay is now mandatory.

title: Zimmer Biomet Preference
content: Supra Ortho uses Zimmer Biomet as the preferred TKR (Total Knee Replacement) implant vendor. Smith & Nephew implants are reserved for revision cases only.

title: Ortho Budget FY2026
content: FY2026 Orthopaedics budget: 4.2 Cr total. Breakdown — Implants 45%, Staffing 30%, Equipment 15%, Training 10%. CONFIDENTIAL — visible to HOD and Admin only.

title: Night Shift Handover
content: Night shift handover must be a 15-minute structured handover using SBAR format (Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation). Must include: pending labs, new admissions in the past 4 hours, and patients scheduled for morning surgery.

title: Warfarin-NSAID Interaction
content: CRITICAL: Never prescribe NSAIDs to patients on Warfarin. Risk of life-threatening GI bleed. Use Paracetamol for pain management instead.

title: Verbal Orders Policy
content: NEVER accept verbal orders for medication changes without written confirmation within 1 hour. Exception: cardiac arrest situations only. Incident in 2023: a wrong dose was given due to a mishearing of a verbal order — this policy exists because of that incident.

title: Formulary Brands
content: Supra preferred formulary brands: Paracetamol (Calpol/Dolo), Omeprazole (Omez), Amoxicillin (Mox), Metformin (Glycomet).

title: Padma Fasting DM
content: Mrs. Padma, 62F, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. Observes Ekadashi fasting twice monthly. Had 3 hypoglycemia episodes in 2025 before the diabetic fasting protocol was adjusted for her (see Diabetic Fasting Protocol — skip Glimepiride on fast days).

title: Hospital Expansion Plan
content: Board-approved expansion: 80 additional beds by Q4 2027. 85 Cr investment. STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL — Admin only.

title: Emergency Codes
content: Code Blue: cardiac arrest. Code Red: fire. Code Pink: infant abduction. Code Grey: combative patient.
